subtopics.label: Sepsis and Multi-Organ Dysfunction in Critical Illness
subtopics.description: Research on sepsis pathophysiology, subphenotyping by organ dysfunction trajectory, vasopressor use, corticosteroid therapy, and outcomes in critically ill patients with sepsis-induced ARDS and multi-organ failure. Includes molecular and immune mechanisms underlying sepsis-associated cognitive dysfunction and microvascular injury.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Hospitalization: Clinical Characteristics, Severity, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining clinical features, risk factors, comorbidities, and in-hospital mortality among patients hospitalized with COVID-19, including variant-specific severity comparisons (Delta, Omicron, Beta) and predictive biomarkers such as troponin, viral load, and inflammatory markers.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Cardiovascular and Thrombotic Complications
subtopics.description: Research on cardiac manifestations of COVID-19 including myocarditis, arrhythmias, right ventricular dysfunction, pulmonary embolism, thrombotic events, and anticoagulation management in hospitalized COVID-19 patients.

subtopics.label: ICU Operations, Staffing, and Quality Improvement
subtopics.description: Research on ICU staffing models, patient-to-intensivist ratios, bed-to-physician ratios, interprofessional staffing patterns, quality improvement initiatives for clinical deterioration communication, and patient safety huddles in intensive care settings.

subtopics.label: Resuscitation Science and Cardiac Arrest Management
subtopics.description: Studies on out-of-hospital and in-hospital cardiac arrest resuscitation including CPR training programs, bystander CPR, REBOA, resuscitative transesophageal echocardiography, epinephrine use, EEG prognostication post-arrest, and mechanical circulatory support in cardiac arrest.

subtopics.label: Acute Pulmonary Embolism: Risk Stratification and Catheter-Based Therapies
subtopics.description: Research on risk stratification tools, catheter-directed thrombolysis, mechanical thrombectomy, surgical embolectomy, and anticoagulation strategies for acute pulmonary embolism, including outcomes in intermediate- and high-risk patients and access disparities.

subtopics.label: Cardiogenic Shock and Mechanical Circulatory Support
subtopics.description: Studies on management of cardiogenic shock including mechanical circulatory support devices (Impella, IABP, VA-ECMO, LVAD), outcomes at specialized centers, socioeconomic disparities in device utilization, sex-based differences, and trends in MCS use following heart allocation policy changes.

subtopics.label: Stroke and Cerebrovascular Emergencies in the ED
subtopics.description: Research on emergency department diagnosis, misdiagnosis, and management of ischemic stroke, TIA, intracerebral hemorrhage, and subarachnoid hemorrhage, including mobile stroke units, thrombectomy access, diagnostic error analysis, and risk stratification after ED headache visits.

subtopics.label: Traumatic Injury Management and Trauma Systems
subtopics.description: Research on management of traumatic injuries including traumatic brain injury, spinal cord injury, blunt thoracic aortic injury, rib fractures, facial fractures, and hemorrhage control, as well as trauma system design, volume-outcome relationships, and outcomes in both high-income and low-resource settings.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Critical Care: Delirium, Transfusion, and PICU Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies on pediatric intensive care including delirium assessment and outcomes, blood product transfusion practices in critically ill children and those on ECMO, bleeding assessment, sedation practices, and PICU staffing and quality metrics.

subtopics.label: Emergency Department Operations, Telemedicine, and Care Delivery
subtopics.description: Research on ED workflow optimization, telemedicine and virtual urgent care programs, patient navigator programs, discharge processes, return visit prediction, health information technology, and care coordination in emergency settings.

subtopics.label: Elder Mistreatment Identification and Response in Emergency Settings
subtopics.description: Research on screening, assessment tools, interdisciplinary response teams, and outcomes for elder mistreatment in emergency departments and hospitals, including the Vulnerable Elder Protection Team model, social worker roles, prehospital documentation, and community multidisciplinary team approaches.

subtopics.label: Opioid Use Disorder and Substance Use in Emergency Settings
subtopics.description: Studies on emergency department-initiated buprenorphine for opioid use disorder, prescription drug monitoring programs, cost-effectiveness of MOUD implementation, stigma reduction, and healthcare utilization patterns among patients with opioid and substance use disorders presenting to emergency settings.

subtopics.label: Global Emergency Care and Trauma in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Research on emergency care systems, trauma management, prehospital EMS, and outcomes in low- and middle-income countries including Tanzania, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Kenya, covering traumatic spinal injuries, out-of-hospital cardiac arrest, heat emergencies, and capacity building for emergency response.

subtopics.label: Neurocritical Care and Acute Brain Injury Management
subtopics.description: Research on management and outcomes of intracerebral hemorrhage, subarachnoid hemorrhage, traumatic brain injury, and disorders of consciousness in critical care settings, including EEG monitoring, ICP management, cognitive motor dissociation, and prognostication tools.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Pathophysiology, Biomarkers, and Molecular Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research investigating the biological mechanisms of severe COVID-19 including vascular injury, cytokine profiles, epigenetic signatures, multi-omics, and laboratory biomarkers that predict disease severity and mortality.

subtopics.label: Neurological Complications and Cognitive Sequelae of COVID-19
subtopics.description: Studies examining neurological manifestations of COVID-19 including stroke risk, brain imaging findings, prolonged unconsciousness, cognitive deficits, posterior reversible encephalopathy, and post-acute neurological sequelae.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Treatment: Immunomodulators, Antivirals, and Therapeutic Strategies
subtopics.description: Clinical studies and reviews evaluating pharmacological treatments for COVID-19 including immunomodulators (anakinra, infliximab, vilobelimab), antivirals (remdesivir), hydroxychloroquine, and evolving therapeutic paradigms.

subtopics.label: Hospital and Departmental Operations During the COVID-19 Pandemic
subtopics.description: Studies describing institutional adaptations during COVID-19 including surgical shutdowns, departmental restructuring, simulation training, resource reallocation, palliative care expansion, and ethical frameworks for crisis standards of care.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Outcomes in Patients with Specific Comorbidities and Special Populations
subtopics.description: Research examining COVID-19 severity and outcomes in patients with specific conditions including cancer, CKD, diabetes, Parkinson's disease, rheumatic diseases, pregnancy, and the oldest-old, as well as variant-specific severity analyses.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Respiratory Failure: Mechanical Ventilation, Proning, and Pulmonary Complications
subtopics.description: Studies on respiratory management of COVID-19 including mechanical ventilation strategies, awake proning, barotrauma, pneumothorax, intrathoracic complications, tracheostomy, and ARDS-related outcomes.

subtopics.label: Post-Acute COVID-19 Sequelae and Long COVID Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research characterizing post-COVID-19 syndrome including persistent symptoms, effort intolerance, cardiopulmonary dysfunction, post-intensive care syndrome, gender disparities in recovery, and 30-day post-discharge outcomes.

subtopics.label: Antimicrobial Resistance, Rapid Diagnostics, and Stewardship
subtopics.description: Studies on detection and management of multidrug-resistant organisms including carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, rapid molecular diagnostics, polymyxin breakpoints, and antimicrobial stewardship programs.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Transfusion Practices and Blood Product Management
subtopics.description: Research on blood component transfusion practices in hospitalized and critically ill children including platelet transfusions, cardiac surgery transfusions, fibrinogen replacement, storage duration effects, and transfusion-associated outcomes.

subtopics.label: Lung Transplantation and ECMO: Perioperative Outcomes and Complications
subtopics.description: Studies examining outcomes of lung transplantation including primary graft dysfunction prediction, perioperative ECMO use, retransplantation in cystic fibrosis, intraoperative lactate as predictor, and ECMO withdrawal decisions.

subtopics.label: Palliative Care, End-of-Life Ethics, and Surrogate Decision-Making in Critical Illness
subtopics.description: Research on palliative care delivery, ethical consultations, surrogate decision-maker support, do-not-resuscitate orders, disorders of consciousness ethics, and end-of-life care frameworks in critical and emergency settings.

subtopics.label: Clinical Informatics, AI, and Data Science in Critical and Emergency Care
subtopics.description: Studies applying machine learning, deep learning, federated learning, reinforcement learning, and electronic health record data systems to improve ICU mortality prediction, AKI sub-phenotyping, COVID-19 monitoring, and emergency care documentation.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Surgery: Perioperative Management and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on outcomes and management in cardiac surgery including vasoactive medication use, pulmonary artery catheter use, subclinical hypothyroidism effects, CABG in low ejection fraction, robotic mitral surgery, and aortic dissection repair.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Emergency Department: Acute Illness Presentations and Management
subtopics.description: Studies on acute pediatric conditions presenting to the ED including osteomyelitis, febrile infants, croup, BRUE, MIS-C, concussion, mental health emergencies, and pediatric early warning scores.

subtopics.label: Hypertension, Cardiac Biomarkers, and Acute Coronary Syndromes in Emergency Settings
subtopics.description: Research on management of severe hypertension in the ED, cardiac troponin assay performance, STEMI complications including hypoglycemia and diabetes, Takotsubo syndrome outcomes, and anticoagulation for new atrial fibrillation.
